sources.delivered_tokens_and_observed_share: llm_d_epp_maas_fairness_contended_service_tokens_total, scraped directly from the EPP's /metrics immediately before and after the run (same mechanism as deploy/poc/13-loadgen-poisson.sh). This is the EPP's own accounting -- the generator cannot see token usage. Reused unmodified from the SLI deploy/grafana-dashboard.yaml (UNI-50) already defines; this report does not invent a second definition of delivered share.
sources.offered_and_delivered_requests: deploy/poc/04-loadgen.yaml's own run.sh: the 'load: tenants=...' line for offered worker counts, and the TENANT/TOTAL/P50_SEC/P95_SEC/STATUSES table for delivered requests, status tally, and latency.
sources.expected_share: each offered group's configured_weight divided by the sum of configured_weight over OFFERED groups only (excludes the never-offered 'unclassified' catch-all and any group this scenario left idle), so a work-conserving policy absorbing an idle group's share is not scored as a deviation. Also excludes any 'capped_groups' entry (UNI-134's app2-trickle): a group offered but structurally unable to reach a weight-proportional share at its own worker count is scored on a dedicated 'did it get served' check instead, not folded into the other groups' expected-share denominator.
sources.request_share_pct: UNI-146 (C1): the SAME expected_share target above, scored against requests_total (plain request count, from the loadgen log) instead of delivered weighted tokens -- informational only, never part of the verdict. Equal to observed_share_pct when every offered group's requests are uniform cost (every scenario before this ticket); expected to diverge when request cost is asymmetric across groups.
